scope: Documentation correction only. No source/library/binary or actual historical capture changes.

policy.input: Original source RigWeights and actual Mhclo helper map; no reference weights as candidate input.
policy.aggregation: Sum signed Mhclo contributions for each proxy vertex and bone, using positive helper-bone input weights as the existing source does.
policy.additional_bridge_filter: Retain only each final per-bone aggregate strictly greater than zero; do not clamp individual negative terms before summing.
policy.stored_rows: full_joint_influences are already positive-filtered aggregates before retained-row normalization, not every raw signed influence.
policy.deformation: Normalize each retained positive row by its positive sum, then CPU linear blend skinning.
policy.legacy_gpu4: Signed aggregation, top-four selection without final positive-only filter, then selected-row normalization; negative stored weights can remain.
policy.mpfb_reference: Retains only final interpolated average_weight strictly greater than 0.001. Bridge uses >0 instead.

source_references.supports: Signed Mhclo coefficients are parsed and normalized; negative coefficients are retained.
Source GPU4 aggregates signed proxy terms, selects four without final positive filtering, then normalizes.
Read-only original source helper weights accessor.
Bridge aggregates signed contributions and retains only final per-bone weight > 0; comment Every raw influence is retained is overly broad.
Stored full rows are positive-filtered before retained-row normalization during CPU deformation.
MPFB sums signed interpolation and retains only final average_weight > 0.001.
Selected full CPU route reads the bridge frame, including retained legacy attributes.
CPU display uploads already-deformed position/normal/tangent arrays; legacy joint attributes are not the CPU deformation input.

observations.negative_aggregate_method: Read-only f32 evaluation of the existing loader normalization and signed helper-weight sum on approved55 data; no candidate build or execution.
observations.legacy_context: Only486/792 retain negatives after source GPU4 top-four selection;685 negatives fall outside the selected four.

normalized_distribution_difference.explanation: Bridge keeps the two small positive aggregates; MPFB strict >0.001 omits them. Remaining rows normalize differently.

superseded_descriptions: raw transferred influences without the positive-filter qualification
unchanged signed source full transfer with only the four-influence cap removed
historical_evidence_policy: Historical source comments, snapshots, labels and actual capture bytes remain unchanged; interpret them with this explicit policy clarification.
numeric_gate: Existing actual geometry/arithmetic gate remains valid for this exact positive-filtered CPU bridge. This clarification does not upgrade GPU4 or establish product admission.
